title: Look test: anime heroes with Malay heritage art
problem: The owner likes Demon Slayer's art style (DEC-018). Before any money goes on real art, we need to see whether anime heroes with Malay patterns and heritage-art ultimates read well on a phone and feel right.
scope: A 'Look' switch in the settings menu: Hikayat (default) or the test look; the choice is remembered on the device

All 20 heroes in the test look through the shared drawing parts: thicker painterly outlines, hard two-tone shading, anime eyes and hair, and one signature Malay pattern each (songket, batik or a woodcarving motif) on the main garment
Hero portraits (panels, draft, versus screen, ultimate banners) in the same look
Troops get matching outlines and shading (no new designs)
Three ultimates redrawn as heritage art: Kail's water as a batik wave, Benteng's dome as songket gold, Senja's moon as a wayang shadow
Docs (a test-look section in art-style.md), phone-check screenshots of both looks, records
exclusions: Making the test look the default
Copying the show's characters, patterns, colours or effects; only the approach is borrowed
Restyling the map, towers and menus (they stay Hikayat)

acceptance.text: The settings switch changes every hero, portrait and troop between the two looks, and the choice is remembered (browser check)
Readable at play size: the 20 heroes in the test look are distinct as grey silhouettes and at 34 px (screenshots reviewed)
Three heritage-art ultimates (Kail, Benteng, Senja) show in the test look (browser check screenshots)
Speed: drawing 100 cached figures stays under 1 ms on average, as now (measured)
Game unchanged: verify, determinism, soak and phone check pass; no change in src/game
Owner's verdict: is this the look for the full game?

risks: Code-drawn anime looks simpler than real anime art: the test shows direction, not final quality
Faces and hair may not read at 34 px; T2 checks this
Extra drawing could slow older phones; figures stay cached as now (T4)
Borrowing an approach is normal; copying designs is not. General research, not legal advice
cost: RM0 (code-drawn; no new services or dependencies).
